ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there is an upper benzene ring connected to an NH2 group, appearing as an aniline fragment; below, there is another benzene ring connected to a carbonyl group, and the carbonyl group is then connected to an adjacent bromine-containing carbon. Reasoning: Count non-hydrogen bonds by fragment. In the upper aniline fragment, the benzene ring has 6 intra-ring bonds, and there is 1 C-N bond from the benzene ring to NH2, for a total of 7; NH bonds are not counted. In the lower fragment, the benzene ring has 6 intra-ring bonds, there is 1 bond from the benzene ring to the carbonyl carbon, carbonyl C=O counts as 1 bond, there is 1 bond from the carbonyl carbon to the adjacent carbon, and there is 1 C-Br bond from the adjacent carbon to Br, for a total of 10. The total is 7 + 10 = 17.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Count non-hydrogen bonds by fragment. The upper phenyl-NH2 fragment has 6 bonds around the benzene ring plus 1 C-N bond to NH2, giving 7. The lower fragment has 6 bonds around its benzene ring plus 1 bond from the ring to the carbonyl carbon, 1 C=O bond, 1 bond from the carbonyl carbon to the adjacent carbon, and 1 C-Br bond, giving 10. Add all visible components: 7 + 10 = 17.

推理：按片段计数非氢键。上方苯胺片段中，苯环有 6 个环内键，苯环到 NH2 的 C-N 键有 1 个，共 7 个；NH 键不计。下方片段中，苯环有 6 个环内键，苯环到羰基碳有 1 个键，羰基 C=O 算 1 个键，羰基碳到相邻碳有 1 个键，相邻碳到 Br 有 1 个 C-Br 键，共 10 个。总数为 7 + 10 = 17。
